Implemented FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task for PUB013 (office HVAC multi-mode energy-saving control) and it compiled successfully against the real CODESYS backend (0 errors, 0 warnings).

Behavior implemented:
- Valid selector values 0..3 (out-of-range defensively yields 0 °C).
- Restartable 30 s fan delay via TON: permit = OCCUPANCY_DETECTED AND HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR <> 3; SUPPLY_FAN_RUN := TON.Q. Occupancy loss or Night drops the permit in the same scan, clearing the output and resetting elapsed time, so recovery requires a full new 30 s.
- Setpoint table: mode 3 (Night) = +4 °C regardless of occupancy; mode 1 (Comfort) = 0 occupied / +1 unoccupied; mode 2 (Economy) = 0 occupied / +4 unoccupied; mode 0 (Auto) = 0 occupied, +3 unoccupied in energy saving, +2 unoccupied in standard (ENERGY_SAVING_MODE affects Auto only).
- Adjustment clamped to [-4, +4]; outputs declared with power-up defaults FALSE / 0 and the adjustment is computed on the first (dt = 0) scan.
- No separate continuous speed ramp; the delay gates only the BOOL fan enable.

Verified only by compilation and static reasoning against the interface/scan semantics; no PLC functional or runtime timing tests were executed.
